verification.notes: Copied values: C-HR 1.2T FWD trunk 377/1160 and height 1565 CONFIRMED (ADAC 1.2 T 10/16-05/18 id 261854 / 05/18-06/19 id 290267: Vorderrad, 6-Gang, 1565 mm, 377/920/1160 l). Corolla Combi 1.4 D-4D CONFIRMED (autoplenum 1.4 D-4D Combi Luna 2004-2007: 402-1480 l), 2.0 D-4D 116 PS CONFIRMED (autoplenum 2.0 D-4D Sol 2004-2007: 402-1480 l, 4410/1520/2600 mm), 1.4 VVT-i CONFIRMED (autoplenum 1.4 Combi C + encycarpedia 402-1480 l), 2.0 D-4D 90 PS NOT confirmed (no source found that it was offered in the 2004-2007 Combi; 90-PS 2.0 D-4D belongs to E11/early E12 - consider removing). RAV4 XA30 2.0 VVT-i trunk CONFIRMED (ADAC 2.0 Sol 4x4 Automatik 03/06-04/09, id 205700: 450/911/1752 l) and 2.2 D-4D trunk CONFIRMED (ADAC 2.2 D-4D 4x4 03/06-02/07 id 205226 and 02/07-04/09 id 209483: 450/911/1752 l, Laenge 4395, 136 PS). XA30 gen dims 4395/1815/1685/2560 confirmed (ADAC length 4395 for 2.2 D-4D; autoplenum Cross Sport). XA40 4570/1845/1660/2660, 547/1746 and 2.0 D-4D 124 PS confirmed by ADAC 2.0 D-4D Executive/Life 4x2 (235573/235572). XA40 Facelift conventional 547 l confirmed (autotijd, autoplenum); autoplenum gives 1735 l folded vs 1746 - not changed. XA20 410 l and 4200/1740/1690/2490 only third-party (gebrauchtwagenberater).
